deferred_to_b_contract.requirement: Every input-verification deferred_to_b row must have a byte-identical path/sha256/bytes record in closure.json after clocked submodule initialization. Seal rechecks all rows and refuses any outstanding row.

producer_contracts.all_required_records: schema as required_records.kind, status passed, clock {path,sha256,bytes}; all referenced file pins use absolute path/sha256/bytes. Nonempty failures or unmeasured values refuse.
producer_contracts.closure: complete true; retained_files is the full nonempty absolute path/sha256/bytes set for immutable read-only retained runtime bytes, in addition to full enumeration and dependency records. deferred_working_files_verified resolves the input gate deferrals.
producer_contracts.binding: key_present false; runtime_closure is the closure.json pin; acceptance has exactly policy_bound_both_revisions, complete_process_observation, zero_model_attempts, exact_nonempty_issue_id_parity, positive_control_expected_failure, scanner_health_complete (all true). Django revisions is {head,parent}, bound to its object receipt.
producer_contracts.source_manifest: files is the complete absolute path/sha256/bytes set for every execution file, including config and synthetic tests.
producer_contracts.journal: Use preparation.Journal under preparation.operation_lock; terminal records verify start records and source/output pins. The journal subcommand runs a command in a clean allowlisted environment.
producer_contracts.seal: Canonical reservation remains on any refusal/crash and requires reviewed recovery. Seal records preparation evidence only; it never grants inventory authority.

review_contract: Review JSON contains scope, record {path,sha256}, and reviewed [{path,sha256}]. The human-readable authentic council record must state Zero issues and Signed off and name every reviewed SHA-256; booleans are not authority.
